Hi Laura / Marissa / Tom —

Happy to help. Quick notes for AWS Marketplace (so you can parallelize work across clouds):
- Required items: vendor registration in AWS Partner Central, completed seller profile, valid bank details for payout, and a copy of the signed agreement (we accept DocuSign).
- For procurement: AWS allows listing partners to surface a pricing page; customers typically issue a PO to the seller (Redwood) for seat/usage charges. Please ensure Redwood's billing entity and address match Partner Central entries.
- Timeline: if all assets are ready (marketing collateral, SKU config, pricing), listing can move from registration to active in ~7-10 business days. Delays commonly caused by missing banking or legal signatures.

Links and forms: 
https://partnercentral.aws.amazon.com/ (registration)
https://aws.amazon.com/markets/faq/ (marketplace FAQ)

If helpful, I can open a partner case to fast-track bank verification once you tell me Redwood's Partner ID.

Regards,
Priya Nair
AWS Marketplace Partner Success
pnair@aws-partner.com
+1 206-555-0123

Thanks — status update and next steps below. Keeping this light so procurement has a single page to review.

Summary (owner / deliverable / due):

- Karthik (Legal/Tax): confirm W-9 requirement & contract redline flags / 2025-10-03
- Marissa (Marketplace): submit AWS + GCP + Azure portal entries, upload marketing collateral, create SKUs / 2025-10-09

Immediate blockers we flagged for Skytide:
- Bank account verification for AWS payouts (Priya — we may ask you to open a partner case).
- GCP SaaS Vendor registration requires a contact email and a verified domain (Tom, please confirm contact@skytide.io DNS TXT verification).
- Azure needs the commercial marketplace listing manifest plus an offer ID; they sometimes require an MPN (partner number) on the seller profile.

Attachments included for internal use: PO_Routing_Template.xlsx, AWS_Marketplace_vendor_checklist.docx. Tom — I'll send a checklist to your procurement team summarizing what to upload for each portal.
